name: Zight MCP
description:
Connect Claude to Zight so they can understand Zight links that contain screen recordings, transcripts, OCR, request videos, console logs, network requests, and MCP visual context — without manual copy/paste.

Zight MCP Server connects MCP-compatible AI tools to the visual and technical context stored in Zight links. Instead of copying transcripts, screenshots, logs, and notes into a chat manually, teams can let an AI assistant retrieve the relevant context directly from Zight.

That makes AI support, product, engineering, sales, and customer-success workflows faster because the assistant can reason from the actual recording and supporting evidence.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Zight MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Zight MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.zight.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Zight MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zight MCP provides these MCP tools: download_item, get_data_logs, get_item, get_ocr, get_transcript, and search_items.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Zight MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Zight MCP in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.

_published_faq.name: Does Zight MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zight MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Zight MCP is developed by Zight Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
